title: Red Hat security advisory (AV26-1190)
description: As of November 23, 2026, Red Hat is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10
	All versions

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9
	All versions

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8
	All versions

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7
	All versions

Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6
	All versions

Red Hat Hardened Images
	All versions

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4 and 5
	All versions
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
